caption: The drawing depicts a traditional plow composed primarily of wood and metal, positioned horizontally on a plain, light beige background. The plow has two long, curved wooden handles on the left side connected to a central wooden beam that extends horizontally to the right. Diagonally-placed wooden supports connect the handles to the main beam for added stability. Below the beam, a large, angled blade made of dark metal is attached with wooden fastenings. The wooden components are shown in light to medium brown tones, with visible grain and joints, while the metal part has a dark grayish-brown appearance, showing wear. The composition is simple, with the plow centered and detailed, and no additional objects or elements present in the drawing.
title: Plow
